ai.purpose: RTT/1 engine layer for Quantum Field Theory: operator grammar, excitation behavior, propagators, and minimal coherence examples.

engine.description: Defines the operator grammar and dimensional behavior of excitations, propagators, and symmetries within the RTT substrate.

creation_operator.description: Creates excitations in a given mode of the field.

annihilation_operator.description: Removes excitations from a given mode of the field.

propagator.description: Describes how excitations propagate between points or modes.

lagrangian_density.description: Encodes the dynamics, symmetries, and interaction terms of the field.

symmetry_generator.description: Defines transformations that preserve excitation structure.

interaction_vertex.description: Specifies how excitations interact at points or modes.

renormalization.description: Stabilizes excitation behavior by absorbing divergences.

path_integral.description: Represents amplitudes as sums over possible histories.

dimensional_mapping.R1: Excitations lose meaning; operators collapse to primitive interactions.
dimensional_mapping.R2: Local excitations, propagators, and operator algebra behave coherently.
dimensional_mapping.R3: Symmetry-driven interaction structure; stable excitation spectra.
dimensional_mapping.R4: Large-scale effective field behavior; geometric coupling emerges.

integration.notes: RTT/1 treats QFT as an excitation grammar; deeper resonance and substrate integration occur in RTT/2 and RTT/3.
